card.name: The word to after invert or comb
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after an instruction verb phrase such as "gently invert the bag" or "comb the hair", where it introduces a purpose such as mixing or spreading something.

modes.label: Invert bag to mix
modes.description: "to" after gently inverting a bag or container in dilution directions, just before mix.
modes.example: Gently invert the bag<< to>> mix the solution. • Following dilution

modes.label: Other handling steps
modes.description: "to" or a nearby word after a hands-on preparation or application step.

card.plain: It fires on "to" after a handling step like inverting a bag, where the next words describe mixing or spreading the solution.
